Name: Rasmodius Big Naturals
Author: Mahws
Description:
This mod gives Rasmodius Big Naturals.

We all know and love Gandalf's Big Naturals, but shouldn't Rasmodius have them too? We shouldn't take him for some conjurer of cheap tricks, much like Gandalf, Rasmodius is a great and wise wizard. And great and wise wizards should always have the option of having big-honking-badonkadonks.[color=#616161]

[/color][font=Courier New][size=4]Features[/size][/font]
[list]
[*]Swaying movement while walking
[*]Heaving breaths
[*]Should dynamically combine with seasonal outfit mods
[/list]

﻿[font=Courier New][size=4]How to install[/size][/font]
Once you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed just extract the "[CP] WizardNaturals" folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.

[font=Courier New][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/font]
The only mods that might be incompatible are ones that edit Rasmodius' portrait or sprites. Even they should be fine however, as this mod overlays the big naturals over the base images.

[font=Courier New][size=4]Why?[/size][/font]
Much like the original creator of Gandalf Big Naturals credits the affects of post surgery anaesthesia for their inspiration I'm citing post surgery sleep deprivation. That and the fact that no one seems to have made this mod already, which is just odd.

[font=Courier New][size=4]Couldn't they be bigger?[/size][/font]
Look, there's only so much you can do with 6 pixels. At least they look appropriately weighty in motion.
